_doc: Use-skills (owner 2026-11-23: NON-COMBAT ONLY — combat power comes from classes, attributes, gear and talents). Each rises 0-100 by doing it (Skyrim-like); js/rules/skills-use.js is the one reader. `gain` = XP per use (by kind of use); `perPoint` = what each point is worth (read by the function named in `reader`); `milestones` give a talent point each (talents.json) and the named perk at that value. `round: 2` skills exist in data but nothing raises them until their benches arrive.

curve._doc: XP to go from v to v+1 = base + v * perPoint.

sneak.name: Sneak
sneak.blurb: Moving unseen. Enemies notice you from closer in.
sneak._sneakingDoc: Sneaking at all multiplies how far away an enemy notices you by this; every Sneak point then cuts it by perPoint.noticeCut more (up to 60%).

25.name: Soft Soles
25.text: Sneaking no longer slows you below {pct} of your walking speed.

50.name: Shadowed
50.text: Enemies take {pct} longer to notice you.

75.name: Opening Cut
75.text: Your first hit on an enemy that has not noticed you deals {pct} more damage.

100.name: Ghost
100.text: Enemies you have not hit cannot notice you while you sneak unless they touch you.

25.name: Light Touch
25.text: A failed pick costs {n} lockpick less often.

50.name: Deep Chests
50.text: Locked chests you open hold {pct} more gold.

75.name: Master Hands
75.text: Expert locks are as easy as Adept ones.

100.name: Nothing Stays Shut
100.text: Master locks open on the first try.

100.name: Untouchable
100.text: A failed lift is never noticed.

speech.name: Speech
speech.blurb: Better prices, and talking your way through.

100.name: Golden Tongue
100.text: Shops buy anything, at {pct} of its price.

enchanting.name: Enchanting
enchanting.blurb: Breaking magic items to learn their enchantments, and putting those on your own gear.

25.name: Keen Reader
25.text: Breaking a rare or better item can teach {n} enchantments.

50.name: Second Rune
50.text: Each item takes {n} of your enchantments.

100.name: Third Rune
100.text: Each item takes {n} of your enchantments.

smithing.name: Smithing
smithing.blurb: Making and improving weapons and armour at a forge. (Opens with the forge, a later round.)

alchemy.name: Alchemy
alchemy.blurb: Brewing potions. (Opens with the alchemy table, a later round.)
